name: Grown Rogue Medford Rossanley

nadir.desc: The property consists of multiple large warehouse-style commercial buildings with flat metal roofs|A large paved parking and circulation area is located between the structures and holds numerous vehicles|Outdoor storage of materials and containers is present in the central lot|Landscaped trees and plantings border portions of the site|The property is located in an industrial and commercial area.

alpha.desc: The front of the facility shows the commercial warehouse buildings facing a paved parking lot|Multiple vehicles are parked in the lot|Outdoor materials and containers are visible near the buildings|Trees and landscaping are present along the street frontage.

bravo.desc: The left side of the facility shows the side elevations of the warehouse buildings and portions of the paved parking area|Vehicles and outdoor storage items are present|Trees and open ground continue along this side of the property.

charlie.desc: The rear of the facility shows the back elevations of the warehouse buildings|Additional parking spaces, outdoor materials, and circulation areas are present|Trees and open ground border portions of the rear perimeter.

delta.desc: The right side of the facility shows the side of the warehouse buildings and paved parking areas|Multiple vehicles are parked along this elevation|Outdoor storage and landscaped edges are present|Circulation lanes continue around the structures.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from multiple points via the large paved parking and circulation area that surrounds and connects the warehouse buildings. The central lot provides substantial space for emergency vehicle staging and movement. Multiple vehicles and outdoor materials currently occupy portions of the site. Trees and landscaping are present along the edges but do not fully obstruct access. The industrial layout includes outdoor storage areas that may require additional navigation awareness. Neighboring commercial and industrial facilities are present.
clarifications: Where are the primary vehicle entrances to the parking areas, and are any of them gated or restricted? Is there a designated fire lane or emergency vehicle access route around the buildings? Are there multiple points of entry into each warehouse building? Is vehicle access available on all sides of the facility? What is the primary use of the outdoor storage areas and materials on the property?
